title: Kneel to the Crooked Queen
summary: You sided with Kehlenn in the barrow, and the Crooked Queen walks out of her tree with her new court behind her.

epilogue.title: The Crooked Queen
epilogue.text: Kehlenn takes the Hollow back the way a flood takes a valley, and her new court rides at her heels wearing your faces.

epilogue.title: Her Court
epilogue.text: {name} kneels at the queen's right hand, and the crown of thorns she sets there never comes off.

epilogue.title: The Crooked Moon
epilogue.text: The moon grins ear to ear over Wickermoor Hollow, and it never stops.

epilogue.title: Wickermoor Village
epilogue.text: Wickermoor's shutters never open again, and the turnip lanterns burn on in empty windows.

epilogue.title: Phillip and Adela
epilogue.text: Nobody is left to remember Phillip and Adela, and the painting over the inn's hearth curls up in the damp.
